rows.statement: ERS adult CAP core outcomes: treatment success/failure, mortality, serious adverse events, readmission, symptom duration, clinical stability; mortality/readmission measured at 30 days.

source.title: Core outcome set for trials evaluating management of community-acquired and nosocomial pneumonia in adults: an ERS statement

rows.notes: “The final COS for CAP includes: treatment success/failure, all-cause mortality, serious adverse events, readmissions … duration of symptoms and time to clinical stability.”

rows.statement: ERS adult nosocomial pneumonia core outcomes include treatment success/failure, mortality, serious adverse events, readmission and need for ventilatory support.

source.title: Core outcome set for trials evaluating management of community-acquired and nosocomial pneumonia in adults: an ERS statement

rows.notes: “nosocomial pneumonia COS includes: treatment success/failure, all-cause mortality, serious adverse events, readmission and need for ventilatory support.”

rows.statement: ERS/ESGE/ESTS 2026 guideline: systematic staging minimal standard; combined EBUS-TBNA+EUS(-B)-FNA preferred; 21G/22G standard.

source.title: ERS/ESGE/ESTS clinical practice guidelines on endobronchial and oesophageal endosonography

rows.notes: “Systematic staging is suggested … as the minimal standard”; “21G/22G TBNA needles are considered the standard.”

rows.statement: A 6-month bedaquiline, linezolid, delamanid and levofloxacin/clofazimine treatment strategy was noninferior to the 9-month standard of care for rifampicin-resistant TB; successful outcome at 76 weeks was 86.1% vs 86.0%.

source.title: A Pragmatic Trial of a 6-Month Strategy for Rifampicin-Resistant Tuberculosis

rows.notes: “A successful outcome was observed ... (86.1%) ... (86.0%)”; “6-month trial strategy was noninferior.”

rows.statement: Romania 2024 TB profile: 8,825 cases; notification rate 46.3/100,000; 200 notified RR/MDR-TB cases; RR/MDR-TB treatment success 55.0% for the 2022 cohort.

source.title: Tuberculosis surveillance and monitoring in Europe 2026: Romania country profile
source.locator: Romania profile, Tuberculosis cases 2024; Drug resistance surveillance; outcome cohort (2022)

rows.statement: The 2024 global ARDS definition includes high-flow nasal oxygen at ≥30 L/min; hypoxemia as PaO2:FiO2 ≤300 mm Hg or SpO2:FiO2 ≤315 when SpO2 ≤97%; ultrasound may meet imaging criteria; PEEP/support devices are not required in resource-limited settings.

source.title: A New Global Definition of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome

rows.notes: “minimum flow rate of ≥30 L/min”; “PaO2:FiO2 ≤300 mm Hg or ... SpO2:FiO2 ≤315 (if ... SpO2 is ≤97%).”

rows.statement: The Berlin ARDS severity bands by PaO2/FiO2 are mild >200 to ≤300 mm Hg, moderate >100 to ≤200 mm Hg, and severe ≤100 mm Hg.

source.title: Acute respiratory distress syndrome: the Berlin Definition

rows.notes: “mild (200 ... ≤300 mm Hg), moderate (100 ... ≤200 mm Hg), and severe (≤100 mm Hg).”

rows.statement: CURB-65 assigns one point each for confusion, urea >7 mmol/L, respiratory rate ≥30/min, low blood pressure (systolic <90 or diastolic ≤60 mm Hg), and age ≥65 years.

source.title: Defining community acquired pneumonia severity on presentation to hospital: an international derivation and validation study

rows.notes: “one point for each of Confusion, Urea >7 mmol/l, Respiratory rate ≥30/min, low ... Blood pressure ... age ≥65 years.”
